summary: Round r1 (restricted network). All empirical items are pending; no values were retrieved. Primary sources were located by one web search: the NSO National Sample Census of Agriculture 2021/22 (national report, land-use report, district summary, microdata catalogue, FAO metadata review) for irrigation and mechanisation, and the MoALD Statistical Information on Nepalese Agriculture editions FY2078/79 to FY2081/82 for crop area, production and yield. FAOSTAT is used for comparator yields (calendar year), NSO national accounts and NLFS 2017/18 (with NLFS 2024/25 pending release) for the agricultural GVA and employment shares, and ILOSTAT as a cross-check. The method defines a yield-gap table, three-source irrigation coverage (census farm-reported, administrative command area, FAOSTAT equipped area) and a relative labour-productivity ratio on matched fiscal years.

data_gaps: Crop yields by crop and district, FY2078/79-FY2081/82 (MoALD SINA tables) - not downloaded
Comparator yields, FAOSTAT QCL, calendar years - not downloaded
NSCA 2021/22 irrigated area by season/source and operated area - not downloaded
DWRI irrigable/irrigated area series - URL unverified, no catalog id
NLFS 2024/25 report not located; NLFS 2017/18 employment by industry not downloaded
Agricultural GVA share, latest NA vintage - not downloaded
No unit codes for hectares or tonnes per hectare in units.py

assumptions.text: Yield comparisons use 3-year averages to damp weather shocks; Nepal FY series and calendar-year FAOSTAT series are compared, never combined.
Year-round irrigation is defined per NSCA 2021/22 census definition; if not tabulated, 'irrigated in both main seasons' is used as proxy and labelled.
Agricultural employment uses the 19th ICLS concept (NLFS) for consistency with 10B; broader census usual-activity measures are reported separately.

challenges.text: units.py lacks 'hectares' and 'tonnes_per_hectare' codes; yields and irrigated area cannot be stored in native units. Request addition. Also request a catalog id for the Department of Water Resources and Irrigation (DWRI) and Department of Livestock Services (currently mapped to moald_nepal).

Response to 21D challenge: 07A will use MoALD SINA (07A-L07..L10) paddy production series, Nepal FY, as the rice denominator; paddy-to-milled conversion factor must be sourced (MoALD/FAOSTAT extraction rate), not assumed.
Accepted SIR-AG-1: 07A supplies crop VA weights and irrigation shares (year-round vs seasonal) as the irrigation-dampening input; CO2 fertilisation remains an explicit labelled assumption in 25E.
Agricultural employment share and productivity by sector should share one NLFS observation set and NA vintage to avoid double ingestion.

uncertainty: Entire answer is pending. Main expected uncertainties: MoALD yield estimates rely on district reporting and crop-cutting coverage; FAOSTAT may impute; irrigated-area definitions differ widely between census, administrative and FAO sources; agricultural employment share is highly sensitive to the ICLS concept (own-use production), so the relative-productivity ratio can differ by a large factor depending on the denominator.

yield_gap_table.method: For each crop c in {paddy, maize, wheat, millet, barley, potato, lentil}: Nepal yield (MoALD, Nepal FY, 3-year average) and FAOSTAT Nepal yield (calendar year) reported side by side; comparator yields from FAOSTAT (same calendar years); gap = 1 - Nepal/comparator (ratio). Also sub-national: Terai vs Hill vs Mountain from MoALD district tables. Production stored in tonnes, area in hectares (unit to be added).
known_issues: MoALD estimates are district-office crop-cut/eye estimates; FAOSTAT may reproduce or impute them
paddy vs milled rice basis must be stated

irrigation_coverage.method: Primary: NSCA 2021/22 area irrigated year-round / operated area; secondary: DWRI/MoALD administrative irrigated vs irrigable area; tertiary: FAOSTAT area equipped/actually irrigated. Keep all three; explain definitional differences (farm-reported vs scheme command area vs equipped area).

labour_productivity_gap.method: Relative productivity = (ag GVA share)/(ag employment share); ag GVA per worker vs non-ag GVA per worker, NPR_current per person, same FY and NA vintage; employment from NLFS (19th ICLS) with ILOSTAT modelled as cross-check.
